people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
translations.bsb: Those who led the way admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
translations.kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
translations.asv: And they that went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
